violations.text: The firm did not have a certified food safety manager that is registered with the Rhode Island Department of Health Center for Food Protection to operate. An application was given to the person in charge at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

The plant floor is not maintained in good repair. Specifically, the floor in the food processing area has an area of exposed concrete and chipping paint. Per owner, floor will be replaced within 90 days. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026
